title: Structural query probability as an expectation
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite nonempty set with probability distribution $\pi$, and suppose a finite Fourier basis for the $\pi$-weighted function space on $\Omega$ is given. For any finite decision tree on $n$ coordinates and any coordinate $i$, the structural query probability of $i$ equals the probability, under the product distribution $\pi^n$, that the tree queries $i$ on its input.
hypotheses_covered: $\pi$ is a probability mass function on $\Omega$
A finite nonempty index set with decidable equality and a finite Fourier basis is given
$T$ is a finite decision tree on $n$ coordinates
